name: Love Sucks
source:
Love Sucks is an adult Visual Novel, in which monster-kind has secretly integrated with humanity. Two monster girls, a vampire and a succubus have chosen you to be their date this Halloween! But their motives go beyond just showing you a good time... With the involvement of magical artefacts, monster police, big boobs and a sweet rump, can you survive long enough to save not only yourself, but the monsters too?

Or maybe you'll just let it happen over, and over, because, screw it, the succ is good and there's worse ways to go!

[From [url=https://artwitch.itch.io/love-sucks-night-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Love Sucks》是一部成人视觉小说，其中怪物与人类秘密融合。两个怪物女孩，一个吸血鬼和一个魅魔选择你作为今年万圣节的约会对象！但他们的动机不仅仅是让你度过一段美好时光……在魔法文物、怪物警察、大胸部和甜美臀部的参与下，你能生存足够长的时间，不仅能拯救自己，还能拯救怪物吗？

或者也许你会让它一次又一次地发生，因为管他的，成功是好的，还有更糟糕的路要走！

[来自[url=https://artwitch.itch.io/love-sucks-night-one]Itch.io[/url]]
